spans.s:
Soul,Ⓒs.ⒹAtman m.; ‘individual s(oul)’ pra-tyagAmA, vijYAnAtmA; ‘rational s(oul)’ cidA-tmA ‘supreme s(oul)’ paramAtmA, brahman n.; ‘animating s(oul)’ jIvAtmA, prARaH, cetanaH, jIvaH; ‘embodied s(oul)’ dehin m., SArIrAtmA, SarIrin m., prARAtmA, kzetrajYaH.
Ⓑ
 2 AtmA, cetas n., cittaM, manas n., hfdayaM; See Mind; ‘possessed of a large s(oul)’ mahAtman, udA-racetas; ‘oneness of s(oul)’ cittEkyaM, Ekya-BAvaH; ‘the whole s(oul)’ sarvAtmA, sarvaBAvaH.
Ⓑ
 3 jIvanaM, sAraH; tattvaM, sAra or tattva-BAgaH or aMSaH, sAraBUtaH.
Ⓑ
 4 (Self) AtmA, svaH.
Ⓑ
 5 vIryaM, balaM, utsAhaH, tejas.
Ⓑ
 6 Person, q. v. ‘the departed s(oul)’ pretaH, pretanaraH; ‘heart and s(oul)’ pra-ni-kAmaM, sarvAtmanA, sarva-BAvena; See Heart; ‘he throws his heart and s(oul) into the work’ susamAhi-tena cetasA-sarvAtmanA kArye pravartate-vyApriyate.

Sound,Ⓒs.ⒹSabdaH, ni-, nAdaH, DvaniH, ni-, sva-(svA)naH, nihrAdaH, svaraH, ninadaH, nir-, GozaH, rAvaH, ravaH, vi-saMrAvaH ni-, svA(Dva)naH, svanitaM; ‘musical s(ound)’ nikvA(kva)RaH, kvaRitaM; ‘confused s(ound)’ kolAhalaH, kalakalaH, tumularavaH; ‘rattling s(ound)’ raRaH, raRitaM.
Ⓑ
 2 saMDisAgaraH.
Ⓔa.ⒹsusTa, arugRa, kalya, nirAmaya, anAmaya, nIroga, nIruja, prakftisTa, vyADirahita; (in body) akzataSarIra, avi-kaleMdriya (in mind) anupahatacitta, avipluta, avAtula, avikzipta.
Ⓑ
 2 akzata, ajAtakzata, [] a-nir-vraRa, kzata-vraRa-hIna.
Ⓑ
 3 sasAra, sAravat, sAragarBa.
Ⓑ
 4 avikala, anyUna, aKaMqa, aBinna.
Ⓑ
 5 tIkzRa, tIvra; nirBara, pra-, gAQa, su-ati pr.; ‘s(ound) sleep’ gAQanidrA; ‘s(ound) beating’ tIkzRadaMqaH, atitAqanaM.
Ⓑ
 6 nirdoza, nicCidra, viSudDa, dozahIna.
Ⓑ
 7 gAQa, ga(gaM)BIra, agADa, supariRata, paripakva.
Ⓑ
 8 (Argument &c.) aKaMqya, sapramARa, dfQa-su-pramARa, nyAyya, Darmya, yuktisidDa.
Ⓑ
 9 (In views) viSudDAcAra; satyamArgAnuyAyin.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓni-, nad 1 P, Dvan 1 P, svan 1 P, kvaR 1 P, hrAd 1 A, vi-, ru 2 P, stan-ras- 1 P, SabdaM kf 8 U, SabdAyate (D.).
Ⓔv. t.ⒹDvan c., svan c., nad c.; vad c., A-DmA 1 P, muKamArutena pUr 10, (trumpet, conch &c.); (drum) taq 10, Ahan 2 U; ‘the drum being s(ound)ed’ AhatAyAM BeryAM; (bow) AsPal c.
Ⓑ
 2 parIkz 1 A, sUkzmaM-nipuRaM-nirUp 10 or anusaM-DA 3 U, jYA desid. (jijYAsate).
Ⓑ
 3 ud-Guz 10, praKyA c. (KyApayati), prakAS c., prakawIkf; ‘s(ound) the depth’ talaM avagAh 1 A, ‘s(ound) the depth of water’ jalaveDaM parimA 3 A, 2 P.
Ⓝ[Sound]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹSabdana, muKara, SabdAyamAna, ninAdin, ninadat, GozaRa, garjat, nirhrAdin, Sabdakara (rI f.); ‘s(ounding) lead’ laMbaH, laMbasIsakaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹDvAnanaM, SabdanaM, vAdanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 veDaparimARa, talAvagAhanaM.
Ⓝ[Sound]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹtIvaM, tIkzRaM, atyaMtaM, pra-, gAQaM; nirBaraM, dfQaM, suKena, su-ati pr.
Ⓝ[Sound]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsvAsTyaM, kalyatA, ArogyaM, akzatatvaM, nirvraRatvaM, avEkalyaM, anyUnatA, aKaMqyatA, nirdozatA, &c.; ‘s(oundness) of mind’ cittasvAsTyaM, aviplavaH.

Sour,Ⓒa.Ⓓamla, Sukta, amlarasa; ‘s(our) to the teeth’ daMtaSaWa.
Ⓑ
 2 karkaSa, paruza, dAruRa, rUkza, aruMtuda; sadAvakra, vakra-vAma-SIla, karkaSa-svaBAva, duzprakfti.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹamlIkf 8 U.
Ⓑ
 2 karkaSIkf, vakrIkf.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹamlIBU 1 P, karka-SIBU.
Ⓝ[Sour]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹamlatA, kArkaSyaM &c.

Source,Ⓒs.ⒹpraBavaH, yoni f., mUlaM, kAraRaM, hetuH, prasUti f., udBavaH, saMBavaH, AdiH, udgamasTAnaM; See Origin; ‘to have s(ource) in’ pra-BU 1 P, pra-, jan 4 A, utpad 4 A (with abl.); loBAtkroDaH praBavati, loBAtkAmaH prajAyate (
); ‘the s(ource) of the Ganges is in the Himalaya’ himavato gaMgA praBavati (S. K.).

Souse,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsahasA plu c. or masj c. (majjayati) or jalena sic 6 P.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹPounce, q. v.

South,Ⓒs.ⒹdakziRA, dakziRadik-diSA-ASA, avAcI; ‘to the s(outh)’ dakziRataH, (with gen.).
Ⓝ[South]ern, [South]erly,Ⓒa.ⒹdakziRa, avAc, avAcIna, avAcya, dAkziRAtya; ‘in a s(outherly) direction’ dakziRena (with acc. or gen.); ‘s(outhern) country’ dakziRApaTaH; ‘s(outh)-east’ dakziRapUrvA, AgniyI; (a.; (south-east)ern, (south-east)erly) dakziRapUrva, Agneya; ‘s(outh)-west’ dakziRapaScimA, nErftI; (a.; (south-west)ern, (south-west)erly) dakziRapaScima, nErfta.
Ⓝ[South]ward, [South]wards,Ⓒadv.ⒹdakziRABimuKaM, dakziRataH, dakziRasyAM diSi.
